C.description: Mathematical admissibility: original Gaussian generative distributions, lower sparse prior, upper latent Gaussian prior where actually shown for V2, variances/positivity and dimension constraints, ReLU for V2 lower transition and event-gated Eq37 V3; distinguish experimental dataset splitting E_exp and biological resource claims neither source core C.

Q.description: Criterion-conditioned orientation by source posterior MAP/weighted spatial and temporal prediction error, sparsity regularization and variant-specific gated higher PE; not invented utility, reward, policy or neural free-energy objective beyond source.

P_in.description: At model boundary presentation of prerecorded I_t, flash-lag or memory cue and training episodes selected by experimental input schedule through external coupling. Separately internal local model updates use input signal but not P_in = experimenter action identity.

P_out.description: Observer/read interface: inspect inferred model states, receptive fields from reverse correlation, time-constant fitted autocorr, decoded motion/digit, model perceived object center of mass and cue-recall model neuronal activity. Statistical procedures belong experiment/analysis, not intrinsic K automatically.

K.description: Typed within-system relations: Htheta(rh) generates w, weighted Vk generate effective V, source f=ReLU(Vrhat_prev), spatial synthesis U rhat, latent MAP correction rhat_t and rh, distinct slower weights U,Vk,theta learning; VM optional memory m infer and G plasticity and masked cue recall; V3 r3->w2->V2->rbar2, only first-level-error event-gated upper temporal residual, separate V2 pretraining and H2 learning.

T.description: Distinct indexes: frame t and ordering prev->current; within-frame error-correction iteration u early->late; across-sequence weight-learning epoch e; conditioning iteration c and recall order; V3 upper-state changes at gated event t and stays relatively stable between events. Temporal order T not conflated with K map; internal optimizer iterations not converted to real experimental milliseconds.

rho_O.description: System-relative observables: predicted image Ibar, inferred readout r,rh, simulated temporal stability, per-condition flash-lag CoM and recall correlations projected through chosen P_out and admissible C. External original human/animal neurodata are separate comparison records and never retrofitted as system O directly.

formal_source_equations.V2_original_generative: p(I_0:T-1,r_0:T-1,rh)=p(rh)p(r0) prod_t p(I_t|r_t) prod_{t=1}^{T-1} p(r_t|r_{t-1},rh), p(rh)=N(0,1), p(r_t|prev,rh)=N(f(prev,rh),sigma_r^2 I), p(I_t|r_t)=N(Ur_t,sigma^2 I); original p19 Eqs3-6; operational p(r0) handled by original A-N13,14 even though exact label in old A-N17 is abbreviated.
formal_source_equations.V2_transition: w_t=H_theta(rh_t_est), V_t=sum_k w_t[k]*V_k, rbar_t=ReLU(V_t*rhat_{t-1}); original p19 Eqs7-9. rh has sequence-global generative meaning but its estimate is updated per within-sequence inference step; effective V may change as rh estimate changes.
formal_source_equations.V2_inference: L2_t=||I_t-U*r_t||^2/(2sigma^2)+||r_t-rbar_t||^2/(2sigma_r^2)+lambda*||r_t||_1+lambda_h*||rh||_2^2, rhat_t=argmin_r L2_t, rh_est=argmin_rh L2_t; at t=0 L0 lacks temporal residual and rh term; PDF pp19-20 Eqs10-21, source posterior factor simplifications explicit.
formal_source_equations.V2_learning: After MAP inference, learn U,Vk,theta across time and sequences minimizing the SAME error aggregate; no automatic every-time-step latent/weight update identity; source p20 after Eq21, supplemental pseudocode excluded.
formal_source_equations.VF_percept: Within discrete t after reversal compare model early 10% vs late 90% optimization trajectory; endpoints are source figure-based and no original mapping to human 350ms/620ms physiological latencies. Initial trajectory presence/absence no reported model effect in specified flash-lag test (C-L13).
formal_source_equations.VM_memory: Optional original source p23 Eqs31-36 p([r0;rh]|m)=N(Gm,sigma_m²I); s=[rhat0;rhhat]; L_mem=||s-Gm||²+lambda_m||m||²; infer m then update G only during conditioning; recall infer m from masked initial content cue b_i=(1 for lower,0 for higher) and generate rh from Gm to drive V2 r transition. b_i DISTINCT FROM V3 event b_t.
formal_source_equations.V3_hierarchical: Pretrain V2_1 and V2_2 separately on straight/clockwise bounce, then top module w2=Htheta2(r3), V2=sum_{k=1}^2 w2_k V2_k, rbar2_t=V2*r2_(t-1) (NO asserted ReLU at this layer); p24 Eqs38-40.
formal_source_equations.V3_loss: L3_t=||I_t-U*r1_t||²/(2sigma²)+||r1_t-rbar1_t||²/(2sigma_r²)+b_t*||r2_t-rbar2_t||²/(2sigma_r2²)+lambda||r1_t||_1, b_t=1 if SOURCE_FIRST_LEVEL_PREDICTION_ERROR>empirical_train_threshold and 0 otherwise, p24 Eq37; threshold scalar not unambiguously defined within admitted in-article PDF and cannot be replaced by e_s or e_tau by inference.

system_world_experiment.Gamma_in: Delivered I_t / partial cue influences model inference conditioned on stimulus. Abstract cross-boundary correspondence only, without inventing actual camera/brain sensor history or real physical loop.
system_world_experiment.Gamma_out: An analyst's model output/readout can be measured by model probes; this is experimental reading, not demonstrated model action selecting subsequent W_t.
system_world_experiment.E_exp: Training preprocessing, held-out selection, controlled reversal/flash stimuli, conditioned repeated sequence, upper-basis pretraining are protocols/preparations (and actual parameter learning remains internal model update).
system_world_experiment.R: Realized simulated model path under E_exp inputs; separate u gradient-iteration sequence and t input-frame order; no source-defined closed system-world action feedback.
system_world_experiment.derived_system_world_recurrence: NOT INSTANTIATED_AS_CLOSED_LOOP: paper has state-conditioned internal recurrences and exogenous observation-coupling, but no actual feedback from simulated model output/actions changing next external frames. Preserved separately adopted derived notation as available architecture, not added to Grammar v0 or used without source.
